baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun at 85:21 word 3 carries the gathering branch of ق ر ء, while its adjective at word 4 carries attained honor and generosity from م ج د.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can name a discourse that gathers separated voices, meanings, or hearers into one coherent whole; مجيد marks that gathered whole as having reached expansive honor rather than merely sounding impressive.

activation_trace.role: Collecting and joining supplies the Quran's assembling operation, not just its object-name.
Attained honor, generosity, and high rank qualify the assembled discourse as capaciously noble.

changed_reading.before: It is a glorious Quran.
changed_reading.after: Rather, it is a gathering discourse whose very power to join has attained generous, public majesty.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قرآن at word 3 activates reading, reciting, and teaching recitation; مجيد at word 4 activates magnification through recounting glory.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase can describe a performative vocal event: recitation passes among voices and, in being voiced, repeatedly magnifies and recounts worth. Majesty is enacted by circulation, not left as a static property.

activation_trace.role: Reading, reciting, teaching, and mutual study make the noun an event transmitted between people.
Magnifying by recounting glory makes recitation itself the mechanism that manifests majesty.

changed_reading.before: The Quran possesses glory as an attribute.
changed_reading.after: This is a recitation that performs glorification whenever it is voiced, taught, and voiced again.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ordinary recitation branch of قرآن combines with two material and distributive branches of مجيد: fullness to sufficiency and abundant giving.
baseline_models.mechanism: Majesty can be read as plenitude rather than rank alone. The recital is full enough to satisfy and excessive enough to give onward, so its glory has a provisioning texture.

activation_trace.role: Recitation supplies the repeatable medium through which plenitude can be received.
Fullness from pasture or feed turns glory into experienced sufficiency.
Abundant gift and favor make that sufficiency distributive rather than hoarded.

changed_reading.before: Majid means elevated or splendid.
changed_reading.after: Majid also lets the recitation be heard as replete provision: enough to fill and abundant enough to bestow.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Two less immediate branches of ق ر ء at word 3 carry an appointed time and a patterned course; مجيد at word 4 keeps that course elevated rather than random.
baseline_models.mechanism: The noun may retain a temporal-patterned undertone: a recital that comes due, returns in season, and gives events a directed form. This does not replace recitation but makes recitation time-bearing.

activation_trace.role: An appointed time arriving or being delayed gives Quran a latent due-time dimension.
Manner, model, and directed course turn due time into a repeatable pattern.
High honor contains the temporal reading so it remains an elevated proclamation, not a calendar gloss.

changed_reading.before: Quran identifies a recited text.
changed_reading.after: Quran can also pulse as an honored, patterned utterance that arrives at its due time.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sky is both a marked surface and an array of celestial or fortified towers. Those images revise the focus gathering into a constellated architecture: discrete recited units are joined without losing their visible stations, and مجيد names the stature and defensibility of the arrangement.

activation_trace.role: Gathering supplies the compositional whole into which distinct stations can be arranged.
Pattern and modeled course make the collection architectonic rather than merely cumulative.
Honor and high rank give the composed array its elevated scale.
The non-dominant marking branch supplies visible signs by which an expanse becomes legible.
Fortified towers supply separated but mutually composing strongpoints.
Celestial towers keep the architectural analogy attached to the opening sky.

structural_cues: 85:1 presents one encompassing sky articulated by plural buruj; 85:21 presents one Quran articulated by a gathering root.
The focus assertion after بل can answer the opening visual array with a verbal array.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible marking, celestial stations, fortification, gathering, and pattern; I infer an analogy from sky-architecture to Quranic composition. A live alternative is that the oath image remains external scenery and does not describe the focus noun.

changed_reading.before: The Quran is a gathered and honored discourse.
changed_reading.after: The Quran is a marked constellation of recited strongpoints whose ordered assembly is itself majestic.

context_deltas.mechanism: A bounded duration and an appointment fixed in time or place directly activate the focus root's due-time branch. The split counting branch adds recurrence: the Quran gathers a promised future into a proclamation that can be counted toward and repeatedly made present.

activation_trace.role: The appointed season latent in ق ر ء gives the recital an arriving or deferred horizon.
Abundant favor makes the awaited proclamation promise-bearing rather than merely ominous.
A duration of time supplies the interval within which arrival and delay become meaningful.
An appointment bounded by time or place supplies the promised terminus.
The split-root image of counted time recurring adds a measured, iterative approach to the terminus.

structural_cues: The promised day appears in the oath sequence before the focus's corrective assertion.
A nominal Quran can be repeatedly recited while the promised day remains future, joining recurrence to arrival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies duration, appointment, recurrent counting, and the focus's appointed-time branch; I infer that recitation brings the future into the present by installments. The alternative is that 85:2 supplies only an oath object with no temporal semantics for قرآن.

changed_reading.before: The Quran is a timeless glorious text.
changed_reading.after: It is a majestic due-time recital, repeatedly sounding the promised encounter before that encounter arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence moves through witness and witnessed, human witnesses to action, and a witness who declares from knowledge. Recitation therefore becomes a witness-making event: a tongue voices what was present, hearers become answerable witnesses, and مجيد names the public authority of that testimony.

activation_trace.role: Reading to another and mutual recitation provide the social act through which testimony circulates.
Magnification through spoken recounting gives testimony its declarative force.
Presence with observation supplies the reciprocal witness and witnessed poles.
The witnessing tongue turns observed action into utterable evidence.
Declaration grounded in knowledge supplies an authoritative rather than merely visual witness.

structural_cues: ش ه د recurs in active, passive, plural, and intensive nominal forms before the focus.
The focus's pronoun هو can present the Quran itself after a chain saturated with witnessing roles.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated witness roles, a witnessing tongue, knowledgeable declaration, and recitation to others; I infer that the recital recruits voice and hearer into testimony. The alternative is that only the named persons witness and the Quran merely reports them.

changed_reading.before: The Quran reports witnessed events with glory.
changed_reading.after: The majestic Quran is itself a renewed testimony event that converts voicing and hearing into witness-bearing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Death, a cut trench, supplied fuel, fixed watchers, performed action, and witnessing form a deliberately staged coercive spectacle. The Quran gathers that scene into repeatable testimony, taking control of who sees and who is remembered; its majesty is the reversal by which an attempted annihilation becomes an enduring public record.

activation_trace.role: Gathering collects dispersed victims, acts, and observers into one retained account.
Honor reverses the scene's intended degradation by assigning elevated standing to its preserved account.
Killing supplies the spectacle's attempted terminal erasure.
A long sunken cut supplies the engineered stage and boundary of violence.
Fuel as supplied material shows that the spectacle is maintained rather than accidental.
Sitting in ambush or observation makes the perpetrators an organized audience.
The production of an act distinguishes what was deliberately done from what was merely seen.
Presence with observation converts the seated audience into evidence against itself.

structural_cues: 85:4-7 narrows from site, to fuel, to seated observers, to what they do and witness.
The focus arrives after the later denial sequence as a corrective بل assertion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a staged site, maintained fire, fixed watchers, acts, and witnesses; I infer that Quranic gathering wrests archival control from the perpetrators and reverses their gaze. The alternative is a straightforward report with no claim about the Quran's own memorial function.

changed_reading.before: The glorious Quran recounts the trench episode.
changed_reading.after: Its majesty lies partly in counter-archiving: it turns a spectacle designed to erase people into testimony that permanently exposes its spectators.

context_deltas.mechanism: The persecutors' fault-finding targets inward security and trust, while praise, sovereignty, and knowledgeable witness relocate judgment. The recited Quran becomes a counter-verdict: مجيد reverses the social valuation of the accused faith and gives the reversal sovereign standing.

activation_trace.role: Public recitation is the medium in which the counter-judgment can be repeatedly announced.
Honor and generosity overturn the imposed status of blameworthy deviance.
Finding fault supplies the hostile first verdict against the believers.
Security and settled trust identify what the hostile verdict tries to criminalize.
Praise as the opposite of blame performs the clearest reversal of valuation.
Sovereignty supplies jurisdiction for the counter-verdict.
Knowledgeable declaration supplies its evidentiary basis.

structural_cues: 85:8 frames belief as the sole alleged offense and immediately names might and praise.
85:9 follows with dominion and comprehensive witnessing before later بل corrections.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hostile fault-finding, secure trust, praise opposed to blame, sovereign rule, and informed witness; I infer a juridical reversal carried by recitation. The alternative is that the divine names console without changing how مجيد functions in the focus.

changed_reading.before: Majid is a general commendation of the Quran.
changed_reading.after: Majid marks the Quran as a sovereign counter-verdict that converts persecuted belief from an alleged fault into publicly vindicated honor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The metal-assay branch of فتنة and the painful fire branch of حريق make ordeal a test of material truth. Applied back to مجيد, glory is not decorative polish but a quality disclosed under attempted burning; Quranic gathering retains what the ordeal proves rather than what violence tries to dictate.

activation_trace.role: Gathering retains the persons and truths that the assay separates and exposes.
Attained honor is recast as a quality revealed under pressure.
Testing metal and humans supplies the assay mechanism that reveals composition.
Burning and blackening supply the material pressure of that test.
Scorching pain prevents the assay image from aestheticizing the victims' ordeal.

structural_cues: 85:10 repeats punishment language after naming those who subjected believers to فتنة.
The focus's positive predicate follows the denial and encompassing clauses, so evaluation remains contested until the correction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies metal-testing, burning, pain, gathering, and attained honor; I infer that ordeal reveals the durability of the truth the Quran gathers. A materially live alternative is that the assay concerns believers alone and should not color مجيد.

changed_reading.before: The Quran is glorious by untested assertion.
changed_reading.after: The Quran's majesty reads as assayed nobility: coercive fire exposes rather than consumes the worth its recitation preserves.

context_deltas.mechanism: Even after the burning, the sequence grammatically notices the failure to turn back, then names protective forgiveness and love. These cues activate the abundant-gift branch of مجيد: the Quran's majesty includes moral surplus, carrying an opening for return that the violence itself did not earn.

activation_trace.role: Recitation repeatedly communicates the still-open summons rather than sealing it in a past event.
Making gift and favor abundant supplies the excess by which an undeserved opening remains.
Calling another to repentance supplies an invitation implicit in noting that they did not repent.
Covering the fault while protecting its bearer supplies the possible outcome of return.
Love prevents forgiveness from reading as bare cancellation and makes it relational restoration.

structural_cues: 85:10 conditions the punishment sequence with ثم لم يتوبوا rather than describing the perpetrators as incapable of return.
85:14 places forgiveness and love after severe seizure and before the repeated مجيد.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an invitation-to-repent branch, protective forgiveness, love, and abundant favor; I infer that the recitation itself carries the opening across time. The alternative is that these are divine attributes with no special contribution to the focus adjective.

changed_reading.before: The Quran's glory is power opposed to its enemies.
changed_reading.after: Its majesty also appears as surplus generosity: after naming atrocity, the recital still preserves a route from guilt through return to protected love.

context_deltas.mechanism: Covered gardens, continuing provision, and channels opened for flowing water give the rare fullness branch of مجيد an ecology. The Quran is not only semantically rich; its gathered-recited form behaves like provision in circulation, repeatedly filling without being exhausted.

activation_trace.role: Repeatable recitation is the channel through which provision continues to move.
Fullness from pasture or feed supplies the focus adjective's nutritive sufficiency.
Abundant giving turns fullness into an outward flow.
A garden covered by growth supplies the living field in which abundance is experienced.
Continuing provision and gift make flow durative rather than a single transfer.
A river cutting through earth supplies concrete circulation.
Opening and widening until something flows supplies the enabling channel.

structural_cues: 85:11 coordinates faith and action with gardens, flowing rivers, and the great success.
The focus joins a repeatable vocal noun to an adjective whose branch inventory includes feeding to fullness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies garden cover, continuing provision, opened flow, recital, fullness, and abundant gift; I infer a provisioning ecology in which recitation circulates sufficiency. The alternative is that garden and river imagery describes reward only and leaves مجيد as social rank.

changed_reading.before: The majestic Quran contains abundant meanings.
changed_reading.after: The Quran is majestic as a circulating provision: a recited channel whose gathered abundance repeatedly feeds to sufficiency.

context_deltas.mechanism: Beginning paired with return activates both due-time and patterned-course branches in ق ر ء. Quran becomes an event whose authority survives repetition: each recitation begins anew, returns to an established course, and does not spend the majesty of the prior performance.

activation_trace.role: Due time gives each renewed performance an occasion of arrival.
A directed pattern supplies continuity across separate performances.
Stable honor keeps recurrence from becoming mere mechanical repetition.
Beginning explicitly paired with return supplies the two-phase operation.
Return after departure makes repetition a recovery rather than a duplicate.
Habit and repeated practice locate the cosmic begin-return pair in recitational practice.

structural_cues: 85:13 coordinates two present-tense acts around the repeated pronoun هو.
85:21 repeats هو before naming a noun whose primary branch is itself repeatable recitation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies beginning, return, habitual recurrence, due time, and patterned recitation; I infer that the divine begin-return structure is echoed by renewed performance. The alternative is that 85:13 concerns creation alone and supplies no model for reading قرآن.

changed_reading.before: The Quran is a completed majestic object that may happen to be reread.
changed_reading.after: It is a majestic recursive performance: each voiced beginning returns the discourse without reducing it to repetition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact adjective مجيد first occurs beside the raised royal seat, then the sequence names effective doing and willing, and finally مجيد predicates Quran. Repeated هو and the repeated adjective relay majesty from stable sovereignty and effective agency into recited speech without making the text an independent agent.

activation_trace.role: Recitation supplies the voiced form in which sovereign authorization becomes public.
Honor, generosity, and high rank are the attribute relayed into the focus predicate.
The raised royal seat supplies the vertical and governmental setting of the first مجيد.
The stable structure of rule supplies institutional durability rather than ornament.
The repeated honor branch creates the lexical relay to 85:21.
Producing an act supplies efficacy between the two occurrences of مجيد.
Will and intention keep efficacy governed rather than automatic.

structural_cues: هو recurs in 85:13, 85:14, and 85:21, creating an anaphoric rhythm around divine acts, attributes, and the Quran.
مجيد occurs at 85:15 and 85:21 with only the doing-willing and army-denial sequence between them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated pronouns, repeated مجيد, a royal support, effective action, will, and recitation; I infer an attribute relay by which the Quran bears authorized efficacy. A live alternative is that the two occurrences are independent predicates and that مجيد in 85:15 attaches differently without semantic transfer.

changed_reading.before: The Quran is majestic in its own literary register.
changed_reading.after: Its majesty is relational and operative: recited speech bears the rank, stability, and authorized efficacy of the sovereign sequence that precedes it.

context_deltas.mechanism: A report that renews itself and a host whose members support one another activate a collective-force reading of قرآن. Its gathered episodes and recited units operate like an ordered host, mutually reinforcing across renewed telling; مجيد can include victory in a contest of public standing.

activation_trace.role: Gathering supplies the many units that can act in coordination.
Prevailing in a contest of glory gives the coordinated whole a nonviolent contest function.
Speech renewed as report explains how old events re-enter the present.
A mutually supporting host supplies coordination among the gathered reports.

structural_cues: 85:17 asks whether the report of hosts has arrived, making report itself an arriving actor in the discourse.
The focus singular قرآن can gather multiple renewed reports into one coordinated whole.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies renewed report, a mutually supporting host, gathering, and competitive glory; I infer a formal analogy in which recited units reinforce one another. The alternative is that the armies remain only reported content and lend no collective mechanics to the Quran.

changed_reading.before: The Quran is a single glorious report about past hosts.
changed_reading.after: It can be heard as a majestic host of reports, gathered so that each renewed unit supports the force of the others.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending builds nested containments: deniers are in falsification and use covering; God is behind and around them; the Quran is in a guarded writing support. Their cover is itself encompassed, while gathered speech is held in a protected medium. مجيد therefore describes an un-overwritable rank produced by superior containment, not denial's successful exclusion.

activation_trace.role: Gathering gives the protected interior a coherent content rather than loose fragments.
High standing names the Quran's superiority within the nested spatial contest.
Covering supplies the deniers' attempted mechanism for hiding the gathered truth.
A garment that lies by its appearance turns falsification into a deceptive enclosing surface.
Putting something behind backs supplies concealment and the reversal of what counts as behind.
Concrete surrounding encloses those who imagine themselves outside the claim.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and control makes the enclosure epistemic as well as spatial.
A broad support for writing supplies a durable inner location for the recital.
Guarding protects the written-recited content within that support.

structural_cues: بل opens both 85:19 and 85:21, first locating deniers في تكذيب and then correcting toward هو قرآن مجيد.
The focus is framed by God behind and encompassing them in 85:20 and the Quran في لوح محفوظ in 85:22.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering, deceptive surface, behindness, encompassing, writing support, guarding, and the repeated preposition في; I infer a hierarchy in which denial's enclosure is itself enclosed while the Quran's enclosure preserves. The alternative is that these are adjacent but independent spatial statements.

changed_reading.before: Despite their denial, it remains a glorious Quran preserved elsewhere.
changed_reading.after: The Quran is majestic through counter-containment: the cover that would hide it is itself surrounded, while its gathered form remains guarded and un-overwritable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reading and teaching recitation meet a writing board, guarding, fixation in memory, and continued practice. The result is a cross-medium preservation system: voice, inscription, memory, and rehearsal back one another up, so مجيد includes transmissive abundance and resilience.

activation_trace.role: Reading, teaching, and mutual study supply oral and social transmission.
Abundant giving makes preserved transmission expansive rather than merely defensive.
A broad writable board supplies inscription as a second medium.
Guarding supplies external protection of the inscribed content.
Fixation in the self supplies embodied memory alongside inscription.
Persistent attendance and practice supply ongoing rehearsal.

structural_cues: 85:21 names a recitable form and 85:22 immediately locates it in a guarded writable form.
The two short nominal clauses place medium and preservation adjacent without an intervening narrative event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation, teaching, inscription, guarding, memory, and practice; I infer redundancy across media, with each mode preserving the others. The alternative is that محفوظ qualifies only the tablet and licenses no claim about human memory or repeated recitation.

changed_reading.before: The glorious Quran is preserved on a tablet.
changed_reading.after: Its majesty includes resilient transmission: voiced, taught, inscribed, remembered, and rehearsed forms mutually preserve the one gathered recital.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the bodily and legal cycle branch of ق ر ء rather than the ordinary recitation branch. It remains anchored in قرآن itself and is independently stirred by the explicit begin-return pair at 85:13. Downstream prose should present it only as a cyclical resonance of renewed disclosure, never as a replacement translation of قرآن.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قرآن at 85:21 word 3 has a branch spanning menstruation, purity, the interval between them, and entry from one state into the other.

activation_trace.role: Alternating bodily states and their interval supply an embodied cycle with meaningful thresholds.
Honor contains the cycle as an elevated disclosure pattern rather than a reductive bodily gloss.
Beginning paired with return activates alternation between states.
Return after departure supplies renewal across the threshold.

changed_reading.before: Recitation repeats the same stable text.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, Quran is a majestic cycle-marker whose return moves hearers through recurring thresholds of exposure, interval, and renewal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is odd because it joins a womb-and-pregnancy branch of ق ر ء to fetus and dense-growth branches activated by جنات. It remains visibly anchored in the focus noun and strengthened by context images of hidden generation and the focus adjective's fullness. It should be rendered as a generative enclosure analogy, not as reproductive etymology or a lexical definition.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قرآن at 85:21 word 3 can carry the image of a womb gathering what it bears; مجيد can carry fullness to sufficiency.

activation_trace.role: A womb enclosing pregnancy supplies the Quran as a carrying interior rather than a flat container.
Fullness and sufficiency make that interior replete with latent outcome.
The fetus hidden in the belly closely echoes enclosed generation.
Interwoven vegetation pushing outward gives the hidden content a growth trajectory.

changed_reading.before: The Quran is a container of already formed messages.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is a majestic gestational enclosure whose gathered words carry a still-unfolding moral world into growth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because the مجد image concerns plentiful kindling in a proverb and is not the ordinary force of مجيد. It remains anchored in the focus adjective and is activated by ignition, latent fire behind concealment, and the tablet's gleam across the context. Prose should call it a counter-fire resonance only, sharply distinguishing it from the persecutors' literal fire and never glorifying their violence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مجيد at 85:21 word 4 includes an unusual branch of taking or containing a plentiful share of fire.

activation_trace.role: Voiced recitation supplies the nonviolent medium in which the counter-fire can travel.
Plentiful fire in the proverb supplies the strange focus-side ignition image.
Sparkling like kindled fire shifts ignition from consuming flame toward radiance.
Latent fire struck from flint supplies energy hidden behind what appears closed.
Gleaming appearance lets the preserved support disclose rather than consume.

changed_reading.before: The Quran stands verbally opposed to the trench fire.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, the majestic recital is a preserved counter-fire: latent, strikeable, and illuminating after the perpetrators' consuming flame is gone.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets the devout or learned reader branch of ق ر ء feed back metonymically into قرآن. It remains anchored in the focus noun and is activated by the context's trust, intentional work, and repair. Render it as an effect of sustained recitation that forms readers, not as a claim that قرآن literally means an ascetic person.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قرآن at 85:21 word 3 shares its root inventory with the devout, learned, understanding reader; مجيد supplies abundant favor.

activation_trace.role: The devout and understanding reader supplies a possible human form generated by recitation.
Abundant favor makes reader formation a gift distributed through practice.
Settled security and trust supply an inward disposition of the formed reader.
Intentional work carries inward trust into practiced conduct.
Repair opposed to corruption supplies the direction of that conduct.

changed_reading.before: People receive an already majestic Quran.
changed_reading.after: The Quran's majesty may also be reader-forming: abundant recitation gathers trust, understanding, work, and repair into a practiced human disposition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is strange because the focus branch concerns holding for verification or detention in a historically specific lexical scope. It remains anchored in قرآن and is activated by watchers who hold position, divine surrounding, and guarded preservation. Downstream use must speak of a holding or verification resonance, never translate قرآن as detention or import the branch's historical institution into the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قرآن at 85:21 word 3 has a branch in which someone or something is held until a condition can be verified.

activation_trace.role: Holding for verification supplies the Quran as a counter-record that keeps an event available for judgment.
Honor prevents archival holding from collapsing into the perpetrators' coercive confinement.
Fixed observation supplies the perpetrators' attempt to control and verify their own spectacle.
Surrounding reverses control by placing the watchers themselves within a larger hold.
Guarding converts coercive holding into preservation of evidence.

changed_reading.before: The Quran preserves a report of people once confined by persecutors.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, it reverses detention: the recital holds the event for verification, the watchers become surrounded, and what was confined becomes honored evidence.

strongest_changes: The focus moved from generic praise to an active gathering and recitation whose majesty is performed through witness, counter-memory, and sovereign revaluation.
The due-time and begin-return cues made Quran temporally active: it repeatedly arrives, returns, and makes a promised future present without being exhausted by repetition.
The rare fullness and abundant-gift branches of مجيد became concrete through gardens, ongoing provision, opened rivers, repentance, forgiveness, and love.
The final بل, encompassing, and guarded-tablet sequence turned majesty into counter-containment and cross-medium resilience rather than mere literary splendor.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's two compact roots supported unusually many coherent mechanics. Context did not force one final sense: it made the Quran simultaneously a constellated assembly, timed recital, witness-event, counter-archive, assayed and provisioning speech, royal attribute-bearer, mutually supporting host, and guarded transmission system. Branch-distant bodily, gestational, fire, reader-forming, and verification images remained live only with explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: The architectural transfer from sky and buruj may be compositional analogy rather than a semantic change in قرآن.
The assay and counter-fire models risk transferring properties of the victims' ordeal or the persecutors' flame too directly to the focus adjective.
The royal attribute relay depends on discourse rhythm and the repeated مجيد without resolving the grammatical attachment at 85:15.
The memory-and-practice extension of محفوظ is branch-supported but may exceed the immediate syntax, which can qualify only the tablet.
The cyclical, gestational, and detention readings are deliberately exploratory lexical resonances and should never displace the ordinary recitation sense.
